prodinfo.prodname: X-Author Contracts for Cloud on Salesforce Summer 2019 User Guide

conbody.p: This topic describes how a template administrator can create a template using X-Author for Contracts (Windows) with Japanese locale, generate a document using the template, and review it in X-Author Contracts for Cloud (MAC).

ul.li: You must create the template in X-Author Contracts using the latest X-Author for Contracts Salesforce Template.
You must disable the Enable Template Versioning property in the Contract Management Comply System Properties.

conbody.p: To define locale settings for a new template in X-Author for Contracts

ol.li: Open Microsoft Word and click Connect on the X-Author Templates or X-Author Contracts ribbon and select Manage Connections.
In the Create a new connection section, enter a name for the connection and enter the host URL of your CRM in the Login URL field. The login URL is the URL of the CRM with which you want to connect.
Click the X-Author Templates tab.
Click New. The Specify Template Attributes dialog opens.

Enter the following values in the fields and then click OK.
Type: Select Agreement
Business Object: Select Apttus__APTS_Agreement__c
Locale: Select Japanese
Enable Formatting: Select the checkbox
Date Format: Select yyyy'年'M月'd'日'
Currency Format: Select Currency Symbol
Number Precision: Enter 2
Currency Precision: Enter 2
Navigate to X-Author Templates tab.
Paste the following content in the document:This Master Service Agreement "Agreement" with XYZ corporation and has a start date of "Agreement Start Date".
Select Agreement in the content and click Insert Fields.
Select Agreement Name and click Finish.
Select Agreement Start Date in the content and click Insert Fields.

Select Agreement Start Date and click Finish. Mark the Agreement Start Date field as smart.
Tip
The Control Panel shows all the field present in the template and when you select a field the Properties pane is displayed under the Navigation pane of the Control Panel. From the Properties pane, under Display Attributes, you can change or define the format for Number, Currency, and Date fields.

Click Check-In.
Tip
You can change the locale of a template in the check-in window.

Enter the following values in the fields:
Name: Enter JLocale
Agreement Types: Select Corporate
Category: Select Category
Subcategory: Select Subcategory
Language: Select Japanese
Click Check-In.
Log into the Apttus Contract Management application.
Navigate to the Agreements tab, and click New.
Select Corporate from the Record Type of new record and click Continue.

Enter the following values in the fields:
Agreement Name: Enter JAgreement
Agreement Start Date: Select 5/20/2019
Account: Acc
Click Continue and click Save.
Select JLocale as the template and click Generate.
Open the generated document in X-Author Contracts for Cloud. The locale settings in the document are inherited from the template.
Change the agreement start date to 2020年8月21日.
Insert a clause with smart fields. All the fields are updated based on the template locale
Navigate to Doc Fields and click Validate. All the fields are validated based on the template locale and template date format.
Change smart field values in the contract management application and click Update from CLM. The field values are updated in X-Author Contracts for Cloud as per the template locale.
Change the agreement start date to 2020年8月22日.
Click Preview Reconcile or Reconcile to view the locale based changes in the agreement document.
Click Check-In.

note.p: You can also use the above steps to create a clause template and generate the clause document.
